summary: RPCS3 Core 659 = the delivered Core 610 plus one folded delta: the Core 612 to 655 records unchanged and the Core 659 change (build-utils/rpcs3/core659-from-655.patch over Core 655, iOS): the early command buffer submission of 561 becomes Automatic for Assassin's Creed and Black Ops II in a boundary mode, where a submission decided at the end of a draw once the GPU has drained is taken at the start of a later draw or after its textures when no render pass is open, or at the end of a draw after 32 more draws (REWINDBOX_EARLY_SUBMIT_BOUNDARY_659, COREPROF OPT561 boundary counters, boot line Resolved title policy 659); Dragon Ball Z and God of War III keep the end-of-draw submission; two ZCULL counter lines (REWINDBOX_ZCULL_READ_LEAD_659, COREPROF ZCULLLEAD659; REWINDBOX_ZCULL_HINT_SITES_659, COREPROF ZCULLHINT659). Core 655 contained: Core 652 and the in-pass read transitions of non-attachments with the MoltenVK dependency that waits for them (kept). ABI 30, the 92 exports and the PPU/SPU codegen identities unchanged. No gain measured: not built, no iPhone run.

route.note: The route keeps its Core 610 file names (workflow, gate, driver, recipe patch, core610-proof.json, core610-recipe.sh): the frozen recipe patch and the driver pins name the gate path, so the executed recipe stays byte-identical to the one Core 610 executed. Every per-build value is declared here.
